titulo: He was ready to fight in the 'war on terror.' This post-9/11 veteran looks back at his decision to enlist
cuerpo: After the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, CBC’s chief correspondent Adrienne Arsenault reported on young people who enlisted to fight in the global "war on terror." Twenty-four years later, she tracked down one U.S. marine she met to find out if he got what he signed up for.
